headline: Edelweiss Mutual Fund launches Nifty Energy ETF
hook: New passive fund tracking the power sector
summary: Edelweiss Mutual Fund has introduced the Nifty Energy ETF, expanding its passive fund offerings. The new exchange-traded fund tracks the Nifty Energy index, giving investors exposure to major Indian power and energy companies. Asset management companies continue to broaden sectoral offerings as investor interest in thematic funds grows. Retail investors gain another vehicle to take targeted bets on the Indian energy sector through index-based investing.
whats_next: New Fund Offering closure date to be announced
why_it_matters: New sectoral ETF option for power stock exposure
winners_losers: Power sector funds gain / traditional active funds challenged
